fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-04-12, the complainant was stopped by a group near Kalai Park Main Street in Thanjavur, and a laptop bag along with cash of around Rs. 8,500 were taken under threat. The time of the incident was given as 16:15 on 2025-04-12. Nithin Balan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000470. Eswari Raj (mobile 9000000433) was named as a possible person of interest. Ajith Murugan (9000000225), described as a person who arranged the contact, was also mentioned in the complaint. Vasanth Chandran (9000000408) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly intercepted and threatened before valuables were taken.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, associate, suspect, mobile number, witness, main street, afternoon
